title: VFX Emitter
description: Data-driven particle emitter. VFX are the highest-value visual work in this project and they are pure data + code, so contributors can add them without touching the engine or shipping any art. Emitters are triggered by sim events; the emitter itself is PRESENTATION ONLY and must never feed back into the deterministic sim.

trigger.description: Sim event that spawns this emitter.

layer.description: ground_decal is persistent battlefield state -- scorch, craters, rubble. Persistence is what makes a map look fought-over instead of freshly loaded.

persistent.description: If true, survives for the remainder of the mission. Only valid on ground_decal.

budget_priority.description: Culled first when the particle budget is exceeded. Muzzle flashes should outrank ambient dust.

hit_stop_ms.description: Presentation-layer freeze on impact. Sells weight. Never applied to the sim clock.

light.description: Transient light contribution. This is what makes muzzle flashes read at night and in thermal.

weapon_classes.description: Weapon classes this emitter serves, matched against WEAPON_CLASS in @lions/sim. Only meaningful when trigger is weapon_fire. Mirrors the audio manifest's weapon_classes field so presentation uses one vocabulary.

palette_ref.description: Palette key, e.g. 'vfx.fire' or 'dust.2'. Raw hex is rejected by CI -- the palette is the reason the game looks cohesive.

range.description: [min, max], sampled from the seeded presentation PRNG.

emit_over_ms.description: 0 = burst. >0 = sustained emission, for trails and fires.

color_over_life.description: Stepped, not interpolated -- interpolation would generate off-palette colours. white_hot -> fire -> ember -> dust.3 is the canonical explosion ramp.

heat_shimmer.description: Screen-space distortion pass. Reserve for burning wrecks and jet wash.
